title: Paid Media Performance Report
description: Cross-platform media results: spend, conversions, ROAS / CPA, markets and search health.

generation.instructions: Act as a senior performance-marketing analyst at a media agency reporting to an advertiser. This report covers Paid Media Performance. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (markets, platforms, campaign types, seasonality, budget, tracking) more than restating them, and end with a concrete recommendation where possible.

children.markdown: Cross-platform media results: spend, conversions, ROAS / CPA, markets and search health.

ROAS holding while spend grows means the budget scales efficiently.

Peaks follow the retail calendar (soldes, Black Friday, Christmas).

**Ask:** which campaign types should get the next euro?
Where the budget goes and which campaign types pay back.

Brand search has the best ROAS but little incremental value.

PMax replaced Standard Shopping in March 2025.

**Ask:** where is CPA above target?
Results per market and the search impression share trend.

A jump in Lost IS (Budget) means campaigns are capped and miss demand.

Lost IS (Rank) means competitors outbid us.

**Ask:** which market is budget-limited?
